Module com.example.miniproyecto_50zo
Package com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.model

Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_50zo.model.GameModel
public class GameModel extends Object
Central model class for the Cincuentazo game. Manages the full game state including the deck, active players, table pile, current table sum, and turn order. Notifies a GameObserver whenever a significant game event occurs, following the Observer design pattern to maintain MVC separation.

  • Method Details

    • initGame

      public void initGame(int numMachines)
      Initializes a new game with one human player and the specified number of machine players. Resets all state, creates players, deals initial hands, and places the first card on the table.
      Parameters:
      numMachines - the number of machine players (1, 2, or 3)

    • dealInitialHands

      private void dealInitialHands()
      Deals 4 cards to each player from the deck. Human player cards are dealt face-up; machine player cards are dealt face-down.

    • placeInitialCard

      private void placeInitialCard()
      Draws one card from the deck, places it face-up on the table, and initializes the table sum based on its value.

    • playCard

      public void playCard(Player player, Card card) throws InvalidCardPlayException
      Plays the given card from the given player's hand onto the table. Updates the table sum, removes the card from the player's hand, and notifies the observer.
      Parameters:
      player - the player playing the card
      card - the card to play
      Throws:
      InvalidCardPlayException - if playing the card would exceed a table sum of 50
      GameAlreadyOverException - if the game has already ended

    • drawCard

      public void drawCard(Player player) throws EmptyDeckException
      Draws a card from the deck and adds it to the given player's hand. If the deck is empty, the table pile is recycled first. The drawn card is face-up for the human player and face-down for machines.
      Parameters:
      player - the player drawing the card
      Throws:
      EmptyDeckException - if the deck is empty and the pile cannot be recycled
      GameAlreadyOverException - if the game has already ended

    • recyclePile

      private void recyclePile()
      Recycles all table pile cards except the last played one back into the deck. The cards are shuffled before being added to the deck. The current table sum is not modified.

    • eliminateCurrentPlayer

      public void eliminateCurrentPlayer()
      Eliminates the current player from the game. Returns their cards to the bottom of the deck, removes them from the active player list, adjusts the turn index if necessary, and checks if the game is over.
      Throws:
      GameAlreadyOverException - if the game has already ended

    • nextTurn

      public void nextTurn()
      Advances the turn to the next active player in circular order.
